## Rule

Input colors {0,8}. Color 8 forms **exactly 2 full divider rows + 2 full divider cols**
(verified: all 265 officials, 0 stray 8s; non-divider active rows/cols cross exactly 2
dividers, so per-axis 8-counts are {0, 2, W} with W>=5). The dividers split the active
grid into 3x3 sections; the 5 non-corner sections fill with fixed colors
(top-mid=**2**, mid-left=**4**, center=**6**, mid-right=**3**, bottom-mid=**1**),
dividers stay 8, corners stay bg. Numpy oracle: `prototypes/task055_numpy_reference.py`
(265/265). NOTE: 2 arc-gen pairs have >30 rows -> unencodable in [1,10,30,30] for ANY
model; the gate harness excludes them (visible = 263). LIVE class-check: truth
5000/5000 = 100% -> deterministic class.

## Architecture 2: BITAND bit-detectors (v8-v11; owner-directed push below 1,500)

The compare-architecture (v1-v7) bottoms at ~2,386 because its final op needs TWO
10-channel stacks (600 B). The bitand architecture replaces them: each of the 8
(row-set x col-set) products the rule needs gets ONE BIT of a U8 —
e8a=1 (line_r x act_c), e8b=2 (act_r x line_c)  [ch8 = union, K8=3],
f2=4 (top x midc), f6=8 (mid x midc), f1=16 (bot x midc), f4=32 (mid x left),
f3=64 (mid x right), c0=128 (tb x lr = ch0 corners).
Row codes x(r) in {134 top, 106 mid, 146 bot, 3 line, 0 pad}; col codes y(c) in
{161 left, 29 midc, 193 right, 3 line, 0 pad}; channel k fires iff
x(r) & y(c) & K[k] != 0 (25-combo table verified exhaustively). Reassociation is
the trick: `XK = BitwiseAnd(x [1,1,30,1], K [10,1,1])` = 300 B, then
`output = BitwiseAnd(XK, y [1,1,30])` is the FREE graph output — channel
expansion costs 300 B, not 600. Codes are selected by nested
`Where(bool, u8-scalar, u8-scalar)` (1 param per constant, 30 B per select) —
the affine-code alternative (x = A + B*pre) was searched over all 8! bit
assignments incl. mod-256: ZERO solutions (popcount imbalance: mid carries 4
bits vs 3), so the Where-chain is canonical. v10/v11 then replace
CumSum-prefix banding with two ArgMax calls (divider rows hold the max count,
W >= 5 > 2): r1 = ArgMax(counts), r2 = ArgMax(select_last_index=1), bands =
compares vs a shared [1,30] I64 iota init — kills ALL F16 machinery.
Opset 18 (BitwiseAnd) is grader-safe: task191 v6 shipped opset 20 Kaggle-confirmed.

v12 stage table (1,052 mem + 89 params = **1,141**): per axis
376 = einsum 120 ('bchw,c->hb' emits rows [30,1] NATIVELY — zero unsqueezes;
cols [1,30] bare, K [1,10,1,1]) + act/line cmp 60 + 2x ArgMax 16 + 2x
Less-vs-iota 60 + 4x Where 120; channel expansion XK 300. Params 89 = oh8 10 +
f2 1 + iota_r 30 + iota_c 30 + 8 code scalars + K 10.

v13 correction (1,024 mem + 91 params = **1,115**): scatter the divider code into
the raw section-code vector, then run the active gate after the scatter. This keeps
all-zero / no-divider parity because the active gate zeros the accidental row-0/col-0
ArgMax scatter, but it deletes the `s > 2` line predicate and the final line-select
Where on both axes. Per axis is now 362 = einsum 120 + active cast 30 + 2x ArgMax
16 + 2x Less 60 + 2x Where section select 60 + Concat indices 16 + ScatterElements
30 + active Where 30. Final XK remains 300.

## Cost analysis (v13 = 1,115; no absolute floor claimed)

**Lemma 1 (final-stage floor = 330).** The graph output must be [1,10,30,30]
(decoder reshape-compares vs the one-hot target; >1 graph output -> validator
reject; multi-output nodes -> None per S14z). Only the tensor literally named
'output' is memory-free, so the LAST node's INPUTS are charged. For any binary
broadcast op, each output dim must be covered by >=1 operand: channel 10 and
both spatial 30s. Cheapest split: one operand carries (10 x one-spatial) = 300
elements (>=300 B at 1 B/elem), the other carries the remaining spatial 30
(>=30 B). All alternatives priced worse: ternary Where 360; [1,10,1,1]+
[1,1,30,30] = 910; unary/Expand/Tile/Resize/Pad/DepthToSpace carry no second-
axis data; Reshape-from-flat needs the 9,000 B producer anyway; using the free
INPUT as an operand fails because output content (fills) contradicts input
content per (channel,row) x col. Adversarial re-enumeration (2026-06-06 round
3) added: Concat-final (operands scale with output); Gather-final (data
[1,10,30,n_classes] >= 1,500 B, or index vectors at 4 B/elem); OneHot-final
(needs a [1,30,30] INT index plane >= 3,600 B); MatMul-final F16 (600+60);
MatMulInteger-final (A [1,10,30,1] u8 + B [1,30] u8 = EXACTLY 330 — an
independent second witness of the same floor, weaker semantics). The 300-elem
operand is data-dependent (fills move with dividers), so it is a COMPUTED
intermediate: 300 B charged. Floor: 330. v13 still pays exactly 330.

**Lemma 2 (current per-axis cost = 362, formulation-relative).** Each axis still
needs an 8-specific marginal and both divider positions. Extraction remains the
only cheap sub-plane read: `Einsum(input, oh8)` emits a [30] F32 marginal = 120 B
(Conv kernel [1,10,1,30] = 300 params; MatMul -> [1,10,30,1] = 4,800 B;
ReduceSum all-channel loses 8-specificity; one Einsum cannot reduce both axes
to two differently-oriented vectors). Divider localization remains 2x ArgMax
16 B plus 2x iota comparisons 60 B (+30 params per iota). v13 replaces the old
line predicate path with `ScatterElements(w2, Concat(r1,r2), C3x2)` before the
active gate: this costs Concat 16 + Scatter 30 but deletes the 30 B line
predicate and 30 B line-select Where, net -14 per axis after the active Where
is kept. Section-code selection is now two Where nodes (60 B) plus the final
active Where (30 B).

**Total: 2x362 + 300 + params(91) = 1,115.** No absolute floor is claimed after
the scatter correction; the previous v12 "certified floor" was formulation-
relative and is superseded. Remaining plausible slack is small and must beat:
(1) the 330 B final-stage floor, (2) the two forced 120 B F32 marginals, and
(3) the per-axis ArgMax/iota localization. Rejected rebuilds this round: a
free-output separable-Einsum term bank needs computed row/col term banks
([8,30] per axis, with F16/F32 Einsum inputs) and prices above the 300 B
bit-detector expansion; a one-iota-share route either broadcasts along the
wrong spatial axis or needs a counted transpose/reshape; MatMulInteger-final is
an equal 330 B witness, not a saving.

## Don't-do log

- **Sub-1000 shave levers re-audited 2026-06-21 (w10), ALL net-zero-or-worse — do NOT re-grind**
  (current floor = v14 axis-share 1,113 = 330 final + 2×362 per-axis - 11 share savings; target was <1000):
  - **(lever 1) Collapse 2×Less + 2×Where band-select into a 3-level staircase/Gather-LUT**:
    the 3 band codes (XT=134, XM=106, XB=146) are NON-monotonic in band order, so no single
    `Greater`/affine compare expresses them (same reason the don't-do "affine code" entry holds).
    `Gather(LUT3, level)` where `level=Add(Cast(c1,u8),Cast(c2,u8))` costs 2×Cast(60)+Add(30)+
    Gather(30)=120 vs the current 2×Where=60. WORSE. The 2-Where chain is minimal for 3 distinct values.
  - **(lever 3) Fold ScatterElements divider-override into the Where chain**: replacing
    Concat(16)+Scatter(30)=46 with `isdiv=Equal(s8,ReduceMax(s8))` (RMax~4 + Equal 30) forces a
    THIRD Where in the section chain (+30). Net 124 vs 106. WORSE. Scatter is the efficient form.
  - **(lever 4) Cheaper divider detection than 2×ArgMax**: the 2 ArgMax are I64 [1,1] = 8 B each =
    16 B total — already negligible; nothing beats it. `ReduceMin(ch8,cols)`=divider-row test fails
    because padding cols are 0 → ReduceMin=0 for every row without a dynamic crop.
  - **Active-gate fold (the cost994 wall)**: only the BOT band leaks into padding (top/mid are bounded
    by r1<r2<H). But clipping it still needs `active=Cast(s8,BOOL)` (30, no free active signal exists)
    + one apply Where (30) = 60/axis — identical to the current `Cast`+final-`Where`. Re-confirmed
    2026-06-21 the no-active pruned probe (`_orphan_floor_proofs.../sub1000_wall_proof/
    do_not_submit_..._cost994.onnx`) is vis **0/263**: section codes leak into padded rows/cols and the
    full 30×30 one-hot compare requires padding all-zero. The two active gates (120 B total) are
    correctness-critical and irreducible.
  - **Shrinking the 240B F32 marginals (s8_r/s8_c)**: Einsum reading the F32 graph input is
    F32-LOCKED (all operands must share dtype, ort_reality Einsum row, task351 2026-06-20) — the
    [30,1] marginal cannot be F16/U8/INT32; Conv is float-only too. 120 B/axis is hard-forced (Lemma 2).
  - **Verdict: 1,113 is the formulation floor. Sub-1000 is unreachable without breaking padding
    correctness.** Matches the 2026-06-20 sub1000 wall proof and the §62b "sub-800 architecturally
    unreachable" measured floor.
- **Don't materialize channel planes**: per-plane BOOL outer products + Concat-of-10
  prices ~9.5k (planes 900B each + ch8 needs 3) — the rank-1 staircase stacks beat it 4x.
- **Single Where(cond,A,B) with rank-1 operands can't express ch8**: its row patterns
  take 3 distinct values (act_c / line_c / 0 for line/normal/padding rows); a 2-way
  row-cond gives only 2. Greater's staircase handles 3 levels in one op.
- **Sub(X,Y) with U8 is banned** (ORT CPU rejects U8/I8 Sub) — that's why v1 used F16
  codes with Sub and the U8 line switched to Greater + Not/Min thresholds.
- **CumSum F16 fails the opset-12 schema** (F16 admitted at 14+); at opset 17 the ORT
  CPU kernel RUNS (LIVE itself + v1-v7 prove it on [1,1,30,1]). The ort_reality matrix
  row claiming "no F16 CumSum kernel" is contradicted on this shape class — corrected
  2026-06-06 (was a task070 misread or different shape class).
- **Min(u8) CPU kernel exists** (v7 gates execution-verify it) — stamped in ort_reality.
- **act-gate the pre-bands** (b0=p0&act etc.): without it, an all-zero/no-divider input
  makes pre==0 fire on every row -> ch0 all-ones, diverging from LIVE (which passes
  ch0 through). Gates cost 120B total; keeps degenerate parity with LIVE semantics.
- **Structural ch8/ch0 vs input-passthrough**: v1-v7 reconstruct ch8 and ch0 from the
  divider geometry instead of reading input ch0/ch8 planes (saves ~9k). Diverges from
  LIVE only on generator-invariant-violating inputs (stray 8s, !=2 dividers, all-zero):
  officials 0/265 violations, 200k corpus byte-equal, structure-preserving adversarial
  modes 100% (rotate/flip/shift/shrink), destroying modes diverge as expected (advisory).
  An input-faithful ch8 sibling would cost +4.5k; skipped per task287 sibling discipline
  (primary is byte-equal class).
- **Unused initializers still count as params** (calculate_params sums ALL
  graph.initializer) — prune dead inits (k2 in v6).
- **ZR8 zeros-init (30p) beats computed zero vec (60B)**; Y's zero slots are free —
  reuse y8 (any u8 >= 0 works under Greater(0, y)). Computed-false routes (And(line,nl)
  / Xor(x,x) = 60B) lose to the 30p init.
- **ScatterElements line-override ordering matters**: scattering into the active-gated
  vector is wrong (all-zero inputs get C3 at row/col 0 because ArgMax(zeros)=0).
  v13 scatters into the raw section vector first and applies the active gate after
  the scatter; this preserves all-zero parity and saves 26 cost net after params.
- **Range-op iota (REJECTED, probe-measured)**: the scorer charges Range's [30] I64
  output 240 B; twin probes scored init-iota 181 vs range-iota 394. The
  zero_param_generators.md "24 bytes" claim was WRONG (doc corrected 2026-06-06).
- **`tools/adversarial_test.py` decode artifact (FIXED 2026-06-06)**: its decode used
  `np.isclose(vec, 1.0)` while the REAL decoder is `(out > 0.0)` — any model whose
  set-cells aren't ~1.0 (U8 bitmasks, F16 staircase values 2) scored 0/all despite
  200k byte-equal. BOOL outputs passed by luck (isclose(True,1.0)). Fixed to `vec > 0.0`;
  v9/v11 then reproduce v7's exact profile (structure-preserving modes 100%).
- **Post-v7 exhaustion sweep (2026-06-06) — alternatives priced, all DEAD**
  (superseded by the v8 bitand architecture for the stack item, kept for the rest):
  (a) Einsum outer-product output ('bkr,bkc->bkrc'): ORT Einsum is F32-only -> 2,400B
  stacks vs 600; rank-2 'bkrj,bkjc->bkrc' for ch8 same problem. (b) MatMulInteger
  rank-2 output: u8 stacks [1,10,30,2]x2 = 1,200B, and j=1 products can't express the
  ch8 union. (c) Gather-from-band-table X assembly: table+gather+unsqueeze = 780B vs
  300B direct Concat. (d) Encoded-state cumsum (pre+2*line distinct states {0..4},
  kills nl/na/p-trio): the 2 extra Adds cost +120, gates saved only -90 -> +30/axis.
  Exclusive-cumsum variants collide states (line1==top or line1==bot). (e) reverse=1
  CumSum for bot-band: needs a 2nd CumSum (+60). (f) Dropping act-gates (b0/b1):
  -60B but loses all-zero/1-divider degenerate parity with LIVE — declined on risk
  asymmetry. (g) `tools/polish_candidate.py` on v7: 0 bytes (onnxsim, safe_opt,
  const_to_init, clip_mul_to_min, scalar_broadcast_ones, slice_axis_collapse ALL
  no-op). **v7 = 2,386 is this architecture's floor; do not re-grind these.**
